Backend pytest 25/25 was pre-verified by main agent (skipped re-run per instructions). All new admin surfaces render and expose their key data-testids. Smart-suggest endpoint returns ranked candidates with score chips + affiliation badges (مندوب منصة / مندوب مكتب). Business API keys page, webhook input, and 4 documented endpoints render. Shared /app/complaints page (business role) loads and the 'شكوى جديدة' form opens with job/category/subject/description and submit button. Fixed one minor i18n gap surfaced during validation (common.required missing in ar/en/ur — form showed raw key when submitting an empty complaint).

ui_bugs.issue: Empty-form submit showed raw i18n key 'common.required' — common namespace was missing this key in ar/en/ur. FIXED by tester by adding common.required to all three locales.

issues: Non-fatal React hydration warning: Emergent dev instrumentation injects a <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> in the manual-match <select> (candidates loop line 160). Cosmetic dev-tool artifact only, no user impact and no functional break. Consider reporting to Emergent tooling team; app code itself is clean.

action_items: Review the review-request selector spec mismatch: filter chips on /app/admin/complaints are implemented as data-testid='cfilter-{status}' (all/open/in_progress/resolved/closed), not 'complaint-toggle-*'. The 'complaint-toggle-{id}' testid is instead used for expanding an individual complaint row. This is a spec/doc drift, not a code bug — either update the request or rename. No functional impact.
Consider adding a lint / global fallback in i18n.js so any missing key renders a soft placeholder instead of the raw dotted path (protects against future 'common.<x>' regressions).
Investigate the React hydration warning caused by Emergent's x-source instrumentation injecting <span> inside <option>. Not a JR bug but noisy in the console on every request detail expand.
critical_code_review_comments: Complaints.jsx line 50: t('common.required') was missing and fell through to raw key because i18n returns the key itself (truthy) when missing. Tester added common.required to ar/en/ur. Same pattern check recommended for any other t('common.*') calls to avoid silent regressions.

AdminRequests smart-suggest is correctly gated: 'suggest-assign-<id>' button is only rendered when s.eligible === true. In the test run, all 8 top candidates were ineligible (active job, unverified, different office etc.) so no assign button rendered — this is expected behavior, verified visually via reasons chip 'لديه مهمة نشطة · مكتب آخر'.
BusinessApi.jsx name input uses data-testid='api-key-name' (not 'api-key-name-input'). Consistent with existing conventions but worth noting since review-request examples used a different suffix.

AdminFinance separation cards: labels are 'مدفوعات العملاء / رسوم المنصة / مستحقات المكاتب (مدفوعة) / مستحقات المناديب (مدفوعة)' (finx namespace). All four render inside [data-testid=fin-separation-cards] with the batch bar + 'صرف دفعة التسويات المعتمدة' button and 4th tab 'دفعات الصرف' present.

rca of the issue: Complaints.jsx submits with `toast.error(t('common.required') || t('cmp.submit'))`. i18n.js returns the raw key when a translation is missing, which is truthy, so the fallback never kicks in. Result: 'common.required' rendered verbatim in the toast. Root cause: missing key `common.required` in translations.js for ar/en/ur. Fix: added the key with a proper Arabic/English/Urdu string in all three locale trees. Preventive: consider a t() wrapper that logs missing keys or returns a soft placeholder in production.
